title: Cosmic Gate pres by Bootshaus & Senses!
sourceDescription:
On October 17th, BOOTSHAUS and SENSES present COSMIC GATE on the MAINFLOOR.

Joined by YOTTO, LAURA VAN DAM and BENJAMIN R, the German duo returns to Cologne for a special night built around club energy, melodic sounds and big moments on the Mainfloor.
